newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends subdued, mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends subdued, mostly lower.

text.p: White sugar futures remained subdued during Friday evening LIFFE trading, with most contracts ending in the minus column.
Traders said the lacklustre trend was due to a similar dull pattern in the New York market, as well as a slow end to the week in Continental Europe because of Thursday's Ascension Day holiday.
August closed up 70 cents at $313.00, but October ended down an identical margin at $303.00. Other contracts were also lower, with volume totalling 1,597 lots.
